title: Sounds
about: Letter sounds, listening games (rhymes, blending, counting sounds) and sound teams. NC RF.1.3 and RF.1.4.a.

title: Words
about: Reading words: short vowels first, then digraphs, blends, long vowels and tricky words, in the order his class teaches them. NC RF.1.4 (phonics and word recognition).

title: Sentences
about: Reading whole sentences smoothly, capital letters, end marks and word types. NC RF.1.5 (fluency) and L.1.

title: Stories
about: Short decodable stories in the order of the CKLA Grade 1 Skills units, so every story uses only the sound-spellings and tricky words the class has learned so far. The child reads each story on the tablet (tap a word to hear it), a grown-up can score a read to track words correct per minute, and a short round of questions checks understanding. NC RF.1.4 (read with accuracy and fluency to support comprehension) and RL.1.1-1.3 (key details, retelling, characters, settings and events). Read these together: a cold read by the child, a warm read with you, a hot read by the child again.

title: Story Time
about: Classic stories every first grader meets, retold in first-grade words: fables, fairy tales and folk tales, and classic books that are in the public domain, read page by page on the tablet (tap any word to hear it said or sounded out), each with questions about the story. The Books to borrow shelf teaches the words a child will meet in favorite library books and links to the library list; the app never copies a published book. NC RL.1.1-1.3 (key details, retelling, characters, settings and events), RL.1.2 (the lesson of a story) and RF.1.4 (fluency).

title: Math
about: Numbers, adding and taking away, tens and ones, time, money, shapes and measuring. NC.1.OA, NBT, MD, G.

title: Science
about: Pushes and pulls, the sky, Earth's land and water, and living things. NC Grade 1 science.

title: My World
about: Rules, community helpers, maps, needs and wants, and North Carolina. NC Grade 1 social studies.

title: Healthy Me
about: Feelings, staying safe, eating well and moving. NC Grade 1 healthful living.

title: Computers
about: How computers and gadgets work, using them well and safely, thinking in steps like a programmer, and the batteries, switches and robots behind them. NC K-2 Computer Science Standards (K2-CS, K2-NI, K2-DA, K2-AP, K2-IC); electricity levels are a bridge topic. Written to be read together with a grown-up.

title: My Body
about: How the body is built and how it works, from head to toe and from bones to brain, and the food and drink that keep it going. NC Grade 1 Healthful Living (1.NPA nutrition and activity, 1.PCH personal health) and Science LS.1.1.1 (what living things need); the inside-the-body levels are bridge topics taught in many first-grade classrooms. Written to be read together with a grown-up.
